summary: Master the Graduation Approach and ALMP integration. Learn to link social safety nets with employment programs for sustainable economic inclusion.
lede: Social protection and employment training helps programme professionals connect income support with pathways into work. Participants assess programme interfaces, map beneficiary journeys and barriers, and create referral protocols linking benefits, skills and employment services. They also define indicators for referral completion, job placement and retention, and build monitoring dashboards to inform programme design and coordination.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate, finance, analyse, deliver, or evaluate social protection and employment programmes across public, nonprofit, and development settings.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in social protection, employment services, labour-market programming, public policy, monitoring and evaluation, or development programme delivery. Familiarity with programme indicators and basic spreadsheet analysis is useful. No coding or programming is required. Advanced topics such as digital interoperability, AI-assisted profiling, and quasi-experimental evaluation are taught at conceptual and operational application level, not technical engineering level. A laptop is recommended for dashboard and template exercises.
